services.name: The "Top Gun" Flight
services.desc: Fly tandem with one of our USHPA certified instructors. No experience necessary! To fly tandem you must be at least 14 years old, physically able to run, and weigh less than approximately 250 lbs. If you weigh more than 250 lbs please call us so we can talk with you about how to get you flying. About We drive from our meeting area up the side of Mount Haleakala through pasture land and the Haleakala Watershed Preserve forest to our Ferns launch at 6,500 feet elevation. After launching you will have spectacular bi-coastal views of Maui’s central valley and may be able to see three other Our Most Popular Paragliding Experience! 3000 ft Tandem Descent! Ages 14+.

blurb: Guests choose from three tandem paragliding experiences involving flights off a volcano with vertical descents ranging from 1000' to 3000'. The Full Experience includes a tandem flight and a one-hour solo paragliding lesson. Flights include photos and last approximately 4 minutes each for the tandem flights.
